description: The firm's private network - Security Six #6. Management, signal and dashboard.
_doc: The gRPC surfaces need an h2c origin (http2Origin); without it NetBird does not work at all. The relay is the ONE possible inbound port on the whole appliance and stays off until a failed NAT test plus QI consent, recorded in the risk assessment. Bringing this module up rebinds every mesh-only listener from loopback to the real mesh IP. NOT CUSTOMER-FACING: userFacing is false because the ONLY manifest-level gate on the public landing page and on the Settings > Customer landing tab is `userFacing !== false`. Without it an operator could toggle Wazuh, CrowdSec or Vaultwarden onto a firm's client-facing page - and the URL the console would print for it 404s anyway, since this appliance renders no route for a foreign runtime. These are staff and infrastructure surfaces reached through Sentinel's own ingress.

hostPorts.label: NetBird relay - opt-in only, off by default

harnessGate.doc: upgrade/upgrade.sh refuses to move this image unless versions/manifest.json marks the target harness_passed. There is no --force: a break in this family does not look like an outage.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.

health.doc: Run from the module's directory in the installer checkout; exit 0 means healthy. Several modules have no HTTP surface to probe, and pulse's probe must assert the pinned build is the one running rather than merely that something answered.
